assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Triangle ABC with sides 20, 21, 26; three blue congruent circles sit in the corners, their centres on the dashed lines from the vertices to the incentre I and joined by a dotted triangle; a red congruent circle centred X touches all three, with a red segment of length 2r from X to one corner centre.

difficulty_rationale: Needs the insight that the three corner centres form a triangle homothetic to ABC about the incentre, so that the fourth centre is its circumcentre, followed by careful exact computation.
